description: Save a view the user wants to keep: UI in the view language that renders with live data. Takes the source, the spec_version it was written against, an optional title and optional state. saved_template_id starts from a view template saved earlier; anything you pass replaces its value. Views are free: no watermark and nothing to unlock. Returns the artifact_id.

saved_template_id.description: A saved_template_id from list_templates; its inputs seed the ones you pass.

source.description: The whole view in the view language, one statement per line.

spec_version.description: The view library version the source was written against.

state.description: The view's saved state values, keyed by name.

title.description: A short name the user would recognise.

name: generate_view
title: Save view
